metrics.title: Prime-age employment
metrics.question: What share of prime-age adults are employed?

source.methodology: Employment as a percentage of the population ages 25–54; calendar and seasonally adjusted.
Unemployed people as a percentage of the labour force; OECD-harmonized and seasonally adjusted.

metrics.title: Headline inflation
metrics.question: How quickly are consumer prices rising?

source.methodology: Year-over-year all-items CPI; the OECD G20 flow uses HICP for EU members and the United Kingdom and national CPI for other peers.

metrics.title: Real GDP growth
metrics.question: How quickly is real economic output growing?

source.methodology: Year-over-year growth in chain-volume GDP; calendar and seasonally adjusted.

metrics.title: Ten-year government bond yield
metrics.question: What are governments paying to borrow for about ten years?

source.methodology: Monthly long-term interest rate centered on government bonds maturing in about ten years; percent per annum.
